You are implementing **Shattered Essentials** features in this repository. Follow `.github/copilot-instructions.md`. Read `development/integration_queue.json`, `development/plugin_manifest.json`, `docs/PLUGIN_INTEGRATION.md`, and the relevant source first.

Implement a concrete small-to-medium dependency-eligible batch, not just a plan. Preserve existing compatibility, do not import licensed third-party game assets or upstream plugin files without verified rights, and avoid competing Ruby method overrides. Include tests and honest status in the PR. A successful code commit is not proof that JoiPlay or the Essentials runtime has been tested.
